requirements: Every operation has an actor, timestamp, causal predecessor set, material references, and result reference.
Every referenced entity resolves to a deterministic record in the same evidence bundle.
Synthetic financial transactions are explicit and arithmetically reconcilable.
Inventory movements identify SKU, lot, source, destination, and quantity.
State transitions form a continuous chain for each tracked operational entity.
Approvals identify the authority and actor; communications and documents remain queryable.
Harness receipts bind durable operational phase tasks; APEX evidence binds exact authorized machine effects.
The reconstruction audit must reproduce aggregate counts, cost total, operation order, and terminal state from retained artifacts.
